desc: Native English. Female, early 40s. Studio-quality recording. Low, warm, slightly husky timbre with a soft breathy edge; slow, deliberate, intimate pacing, like a late-night confession for a luxury perfume film. Neutral transatlantic delivery.
text: Some things are never said... only remembered. Noir Vesper. The scent of after midnight, worn close to the skin, and kept like a secret.
